cves.summary: In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.2, 2026.1.4, 2025.11.8 stored XSS in the agent info popup was possible
In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.2, 2026.1.4, 2025.11.8 stored XSS in the notification rules editor was possible

NukeViet CMS is a multi Content Management System. From 4.5.00 until 4.5.13 and 4.6.02, an unauthenticated attacker can place a multiply encoded value in the news module search q parameter. $nv_Request->get_title() decodes and sanitizes the input once, but modules/news/funcs/search.php subsequently applies urldecode() after sanitization. The resulting raw keyword reaches the {KEY} search-input attribute through search_theme() and the no-results element through search_result_theme() in the default and mobile themes, permitting attribute or tag injection and same-origin JavaScript execution when a victim opens the crafted search URL. This issue is fixed in versions 4.5.13 and 4.6.02.

NukeViet CMS is a multi Content Management System. From 4.5.00 until 4.6.01, an authenticated settings-module administrator can upload a PKCS#12 S/MIME certificate whose X.509 Subject CN contains path separators and traversal components. The smimeadd handler in admin/settings/smtp.php applies only an at-sign replacement before using the CN in .key, .crt, and .pem paths beneath data/certs. Traversal can select attacker-chosen paths outside data/certs, but writes remain constrained to already-existing writable directories and the permitted extensions. Within that constraint, attacker-controlled PEM data can overwrite certificate assets, including a DKIM private key; when the curl.cainfo PHP directive is empty, the attacker can also replace cacert.pem and undermine outbound TLS verification. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.01.

The Web-Based Management (WBM) authorization model does not properly enforce permissions for all PROFIBUS configuration operations. A low-privileged remote attacker can abuse an exposed configuration function to modify root-owned PROFIBUS parameters, including device addressing and SSA settings. This allows unauthorized changes to fieldbus-related configuration and violates the intended privilege boundaries within the management interface.

SportEase is a web application for managing school sports events, class rosters, and competition teams. Prior to 1.3, an authenticated account with is_profile_complete=false can submit an attacker-selected class_id for any class in the currently active event to PUT /api/user/profile during first profile completion. AuthHandler.UpdateProfile accepts the class without validating the user's legitimate membership and automatically derives and assigns the corresponding {class_name}_rep role while isFirstCompletion is true. The attacker can become representative of one selected class, view roster information including email addresses, and add or remove competition-team assignments. Downstream handlers correctly reject access to other classes, so the impact is bounded to the selected class, but the representative privilege cannot be revoked through the exposed API and requires direct database intervention or another out-of-band remediation method. This issue is fixed in version 1.3.

Pozeiden is a MermaidJS renderer written in Zig. Prior to 0.3.0, Pozeiden emits attacker-controlled Mermaid values into SVG attributes or markup without sufficient XML escaping or URL scheme validation, and first-party consumers such as zigmark and policypress embed the generated SVG raw into HTML. The click href syntax can introduce a dangerous URL scheme or break out of an attribute; style, classDef, ::: class assignment, and linkStyle color values can inject fill or stroke markup; color and font-weight values can escape text attributes; %%{init}%% themeVariables can inject global renderer attributes; and quadrant y-axis labels can introduce raw markup. These paths involve src/svg/writer.zig, src/renderers/flowchart.zig, src/renderers/quadrant.zig, and src/root.zig. An attacker who can influence rendered Mermaid source can therefore store script-bearing SVG that executes when another user views the published HTML. This issue is fixed in version 0.3.0.
ml85p in Samsung ML-85G GDI printer driver before 0.2.0 allows local users to overwrite arbitrary files via a symlink attack on temporary files.
xman allows local users to gain privileges by modifying the MANPATH to point to a man page whose filename contains shell metacharacters.
Vulnerability in login in HP-UX 11.00, 11.11, and 10.20 allows restricted shell users to bypass certain security checks and gain privileges.

A use-after-free vulnerability exists in Foxit PDF Editor/Reader’s handling of JavaScript array objects. A specially crafted PDF may cause the application to access a released object during array processing, potentially resulting in application crashes or arbitrary code execution.

A local privilege escalation vulnerability exists in the updater of Foxit PDF Editor/Reader due to unsafe loading of dynamic-link libraries from a user-writable directory during high-privilege operations. A local attacker could exploit this issue to execute code with elevated privileges.
Cisco PIX firewall 5.x.x, and 6.3.1 and earlier, allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (crash and reload) via an SNMPv3 message when snmp-server is set.

Internet Explorer 6.x allows remote attackers to install arbitrary programs via mousedown events that call the Popup.show method and use drag-and-drop actions in a popup window, aka "HijackClick 3" and the "Script in Image Tag File Download Vulnerability."

Internet Explorer 6.0 SP1 and earlier, and possibly other versions, allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (application crash from "memory corruption") via certain malformed Cascading Style Sheet (CSS) elements that trigger heap-based buffer overflows, as demonstrated using the "<STYLE>@;/*" string, possibly due to a missing comment terminator that may cause an invalid length to trigger a large memory copy operation, aka the "CSS Heap Memory Corruption Vulnerability."

Integer overflow in the asn_decode_string() function defined in asn1.c in radiusd for GNU Radius 1.1 and 1.2 before 1.2.94, when compiled with the --enable-snmp option, allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (daemon crash) via certain SNMP requests.

Star before 1.5_alpha46 does not drop the effective user ID (euid) before calling external programs, which could allow local users to gain privileges by modifying the RSH environment variable to reference a malicious program.
BeOS 4.5 and 5.0 allow local users to cause a denial of service via malformed direct system calls using interrupt 37.
Buffer overflow in healthd for FreeBSD allows local users to gain root privileges.
The Sybase PowerDynamo personal web server allows attackers to read arbitrary files through a .. (dot dot) attack.
The Bluestone Sapphire web server allows session hijacking via easily guessable session IDs.
After an unattended installation of Windows NT 4.0, an installation file could include sensitive information such as the local Administrator password.
The SCO UnixWare privileged process system allows local users to gain root privileges by using a debugger such as gdb to insert traps into _init before the privileged process is executed.

Inter7 vpopmail 4.10.35 and earlier, when using the MySQL module, compiles authentication information in cleartext into the libvpopmail.a library, which allows local users to obtain the MySQL username and password by inspecting the vpopmail programs that use the library.

Heap-based buffer overflow in the goim handler of AOL Instant Messenger (AIM) 4.4 through 4.8.2616 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (crash) via escaping of the screen name parameter, which triggers the overflow when the user selects "Get Info" on the buddy.
Directory traversal vulnerability in readmsg.php in WebMail 2.0.1 in Cobalt Qube 3 allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files via a .. (dot dot) in the mailbox parameter.
Directory traversal vulnerability in basilix.php3 in Basilix Webmail 1.0.3beta and earlier allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files via a .. (dot dot) in the request_id[DUMMY] parameter.

Format string vulnerabilities in Livingston/Lucent RADIUS before 2.1.va.1 may allow local or remote attackers to cause a denial of service and possibly execute arbitrary code via format specifiers that are injected into log messages.
Buffer overflow in aVirt Rover POP3 server 1.1 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service via a long user name.

Multiple unknown vulnerabilities in the "r-cmnds" (1) remshd, (2) rexecd, (3) rlogind, (4) rlogin, (5) remsh, (6) rcp, (7) rexec, and (8) rdist for HP-UX 10.00 through 11.00 allow attackers to gain privileges or access files.
The locking feature in mIRC 5.7 allows local users to bypass the password mechanism by modifying the LockOptions registry key.

Multiple SQL injection vulnerabilities in News Manager Lite 2.5 allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary SQL code via the (1) ID parameter to more.asp, (2) ID parameter to category_news.asp, or (3) filter parameter to news_sort.asp.

Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) 5.0 Application, versions prior to 5.36.00.00, contains an Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection') vulnerability. An unauthenticated attacker with remote access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to remote execution.

The default configuration of Cisco Unity 2.x and 3.x does not block international operator calls in the predefined restriction tables, which could allow authenticated users to place international calls using call forwarding.

syslogd on OpenBSD 2.9 through 3.2 does not change the source IP address of syslog packets when the machine's IP addressed is changed without rebooting, e.g. via ifconfig, which can cause incorrect information to be sent to the syslog server.
Cisco 12000 with IOS 12.0 and line cards based on Engine 2 does not block non-initial packet fragments, which allows remote attackers to bypass the ACL.
Internet Explorer 5.0 allows a remote server to read arbitrary files on the client's file system using the Microsoft Scriptlet Component.
Cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in search.php for Jelsoft vBulletin 3.0.0 RC4 allows remote attackers to inject arbitrary web script or HTML via the query parameter.

Instant Web Mail before 0.60 does not properly filter CR/LF sequences, which allows remote attackers to (1) execute arbitrary POP commands via the id parameter in message.php, or (2) modify certain mail message headers via numerous parameters in write.php.

admin.php in AlGuest 1.0 guestbook checks for the existence of the admin cookie to authenticate the AlGuest administrator, which allows remote attackers to bypass the authentication and gain privileges by setting the admin cookie to an arbitrary value.
dcshop.cgi in DCShop 1.002 Beta allows remote attackers to delete arbitrary setup files via a null character in the database parameter.
Apache Tomcat may be started without proper security settings if errors are encountered while reading the web.xml file, which could allow attackers to bypass intended restrictions.
websendmail in Webgais 1.0 allows a remote user to access arbitrary files and execute arbitrary code via the receiver parameter ($VAR_receiver variable).
Apache allows remote attackers to conduct a denial of service via a large number of MIME headers.

Attachment Mod 2.3.10 module for phpBB, when used with Apache mod_mime, does not properly handle files with multiple file extensions, such as .php.rar, which allows remote attackers to upload and execute arbitrary code.

MediaWiki 1.3.8 and earlier, when used with Apache mod_mime, does not properly handle files with two file extensions, such as .php.rar, which allows remote attackers to upload and execute arbitrary code.
csGuestbook.cgi in CGISCRIPT.NET csGuestbook 1.0 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary Perl code via the setup parameter, which is processed by the Perl eval function.
csLiveSupport.cgi in CGIScript.net csLiveSupport allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary Perl code via the setup parameter, which is processed by the Perl eval function.
Cross-site scripting vulnerability (XSS) in MHonArc 2.5.12 and earlier allows remote attackers to insert script or HTML via an email message with the script in a MIME header name.

HelpViewer in Mac OS X 10.3.3 and 10.2.8 processes scripts that it did not initiate, which can allow attackers to execute arbitrary code, an issue that was originally reported as a directory traversal vulnerability in the Safari web browser using the runscript parameter in a help: URI handler.
